verdict.rationale: Penpot's docs describe it as an open-source, deployment-agnostic platform that runs in a private cloud, on-premise, or any environment you control, with official Docker Compose, Helm chart, OpenShift and Rancher deployment paths. Hands-on community reports confirm self-hosting works on Docker/Portainer, though some self-hosters report instability or crashes under load. Missing for 10: the specific open-source license is never named, there is no evidence that the self-hosted edition has feature parity with the hosted 'full platform', and hands-on self-host stability reports are mixed.
